_comment: Research inbox — candidate businesses found via live web research. Run `python engine.py ingest` to dedupe and convert these into leads. Each finding needs: business_name, website, niche. Optional: source_url, notes, contact_hints.

findings.notes: Live website verified. One-stop interior firm (homes, offices, showrooms, restaurants). Site pushes 'Call now for free consultation' — intake is phone-based, no visible online booking/quote form or CRM. Strong AI-agent fit: enquiry intake + quote scheduling.

Live website verified. Full-service firm since 1995, international clientele (UK/USA/Canada etc). Booking is a raw WhatsApp wa.me link + enquiry form. High-value clients but manual intake. AI-agent fit: client intake triage, appointment scheduling, document-request automation.

Live website verified. Has an online appointment form but it is a basic 'Send Request' (no instant confirmation, no scheduling intelligence). Hotline 7am-11pm. AI-agent fit: appointment booking with real-time confirmation, report-delivery notifications, patient follow-up.

findings.niche: Travel agency / Hajj & Umrah / visa processing
findings.notes: Live website verified. Hajj/Umrah + visa + tour operator. Large site with a tawk.to live-chat widget (manual staffing). Visa processing is document-heavy and status-quiry-driven. AI-agent fit: visa application status bot, document checklist automation, package quotation agent.

Live website verified. IELTS + spoken English coaching, 7 Dhaka branches, heavy on video testimonials. Admission funnel is 'Enroll Now' form. Multi-branch = high enquiry volume. AI-agent fit: admission enquiry bot, batch scheduling, free-class booking, lead nurturing.

findings.research_notes: Premium gym chain with2 locations (Bashundhara City + Residential). Membership-based model with high-ticket packages (BDT35K-2.5L/year). Phone-only booking via +8801969-900555. No visible online class scheduling or membership management portal. Competitors with app-based booking capture leads that phone-only intake misses.

Professional wedding photography team with1500+ weddings shot. High-ticket packages (BDT50K-2.5L). Booking via phone/WhatsApp +8801975556633. No visible online booking system or package comparison tool. Instagram-heavy marketing but no owned lead capture. Competitors with online booking systems capture leads that DM-only intake misses.

14 years experience,1500+ weddings. Currently booking2026-2027 season. Contact via WhatsApp +8801626474358. No visible online booking or availability calendar. High-ticket packages. Competitors with online booking systems capture leads that WhatsApp-only intake misses.

Full-service digital marketing agency with web development, paid media, Shopify ecommerce, WhatsApp marketing. Serving 200+ brands. Lead gen depends on inbound forms + phone. No visible AI-handled lead qualification or automated proposal workflow. Retainer clients (BDT50K/month+). Competitors with automated onboarding capture leads that manual intake misses.
findings.web_title: Ngital — Best Digital Marketing Agency in Dhaka, Bangladesh

findings.research_notes: Award-winning event management company, 16 years experience. Corporate events, conferences, weddings, brand activations. High-ticket packages. Booking via phone/email. No online inquiry management or automated follow-up. Seasonal demand spikes. Competitors with CRM-based inquiry management capture leads that phone-only intake misses.
findings.web_title: Ananta Events and Entertainment — Best Event Management Company in Dhaka Bangladesh

findings.niche: IT software and web development company
findings.research_notes: Web development and software company, 1200+ clients served. Custom web development, software solutions. Inbound leads via website form. No visible AI-driven lead qualification or automated project scoping. High-value projects. Competitors with automated proposal routing capture leads that manual intake misses.
findings.web_title: Fara IT LTD: Web Development Company in Bangladesh

findings.research_notes: Event management + wedding planning, 800+ events since 2016. Weddings (Gaye Holud, Nikah, Reception, Walima) + corporate events (product launches, conferences, inaugurations). High-ticket packages. Booking via phone/WhatsApp. No online booking or inquiry management system. Seasonal demand. Competitors with online inquiry forms capture leads that phone-only intake misses.
findings.web_title: Look N Feel: Best Event Planner/Management in Dhaka, BD

findings.research_notes: Established 1984 bakery in Old Airport Road, Dhaka. Custom wedding cakes, pastries, sandwiches, breads. Orders via phone/Instagram/WhatsApp. No online order form or automated booking. Delivery via foodpanda. Competitors: other bakeries without online booking lose custom cake orders during peak wedding season.

Bangladesh premier luxury salon, 3+ branches, 4.9 star rating. Book via phone only — no online booking system. Services: hair, facial, spa, bridal prep. High-ticket, appointment-driven. Competitors: salons with online booking capture appointments that phone-only intake misses during peak times.

Leading corrugated box and packaging manufacturer since 1996. Custom boxes, mailer boxes, rigid boxes, offset printing. Quote requests via phone/email. No online quote form or automated lead qualification. High-volume B2B orders. Competitors: packaging suppliers with online quote forms and automated lead routing capture leads that manual intake misses.

Courier service with shipment tracking on website. Booking via phone/email or walk-in. No automated shipment booking form or AI-powered tracking updates for customers. High-volume B2B and personal shipments. Competitors: courier companies with AI-powered booking and automated tracking SMS/email capture customers that manual booking misses.
